proposal: One fixed4-byte cp.async.ca global-to-shared staging on sm80+, overlapping the existing full output zero fill, wait_all plus original CTA barrier before any shared read. Original old-architecture path retained.
scope: up_show only, same ABI/shape/shared byte count/arrays/float expressions and exact reduction and correction order. No host/plan/evaluator change.
safety: Global f32/u32 buffers and all offsets are4byte aligned. Dynamic shared base explicitly aligned4, all offsets multiples4.
Thread-strided j destinations are unique within each array. Reach and card-position arrays occupy disjoint ranges. No shared source is read before per-thread wait_all and original block barrier.

Full CFV clear moves before the first barrier only onsm80+. Terminal CFV rows are owned separately by the existing planner; up_show reads no CFV data. Present outputs are written after existing later CTA barriers.
Zero/empty and tail cases issue no out-of-bounds loads. Each thread waits its own copies; uniform CTA barrier publishes all completed results.
Inline asm volatile memory clobbers prevent unmodelled hidden-memory optimization across copy/wait boundaries. No extra atomic/event/buffer or floating reassociation.
evidence_limits: Prior up_show host/device traces are perturbed family envelopes, not a removable-work bound or performance prediction.
Actual compiled attributes, old-architecture fallback PTX, raw poisoned-input/full-output controls and complete-cycle timings remain prerequisites.
No variant/width/cache-qualifier sweep after resource or timing outcome.
